verdict.rationale: Cooley GO is a web-based document-generator service and Cooley AI is a firm-owned AI offering, so an agent-facing API with scoped credentials is conceivable and the axis applies. However, the evidence never mentions any API, keys or permission scoping. Probes found no OpenAPI spec and no llms.txt (all 404), so there is no evidence of scoped or least-privilege agent credentials.
